title: Donation intake with a donor receipt
description: A charity or thrift store's record of donated goods taken in, kept in Desk. Each PP DON Donation holds the donor (one of the retailer's customers, whose name, phone and e-mail it fills, or a donor typed in, or no one named), the donor's address for the receipt, the store that took the goods in and the day, and the goods: each kind, what it is, how many (items, bags or boxes) and its condition. A workflow moves it Received, then Give receipt to Receipt given, or Cancel to Cancelled; once a donation is Receipt given or Cancelled, a save rule stops its donor, store, day and goods from changing. It prints as the donor receipt under the retailer's own letter head, which states no value for the goods. The report Donations lists every donation not cancelled, newest first. A field on Stock Entry, Donation, names the donation whose goods a Material Receipt takes into stock (the Stock Entry list filters by it); a customer's donations show under the customer. The app moves no money and changes no stock, and calls nothing outside: no service, no outside address, nothing installed switched off.

fields.label: Kind of goods
fields.description: Such as clothing, books, household, toys, furniture.

fields.label: What it is
fields.description: As the receipt will describe it: children's coats, a box of paperbacks.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: When the donor is one of your customers: the donor's name, phone and e-mail come from it. Optional.

fields.label: Donor
fields.description: As the receipt names the donor. Leave it blank for a donor who gives no name: the receipt then says an anonymous donor.

fields.label: Donor's e-mail
fields.description: Your own Notification can send the receipt to it.

fields.label: Donor's address
fields.description: Printed on the receipt, for a donor who wants it there.

fields.label: Received at
fields.description: The store that took the goods in.

fields.label: Receipt given
fields.description: Ticked by Give receipt. From then on the donor, the store, the day and the goods cannot change. Your own Notification on its change can e-mail the receipt, with the condition doc.receipt_given in (1, "1") and doc.donor_email.

fields.label: Cancelled
fields.description: Ticked by Cancel. The donation keeps its number and prints as no receipt.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: For the store only: never printed.

custom_fields.label: Donation
custom_fields.description: The donation whose goods this Material Receipt takes into stock. Optional.

save_rules.rule_name: PP DON donation locked once its receipt is given
save_rules.message: The receipt was given: the donor, the store, the day and the goods stay as on it. Cancel it and take a new donation instead.
